description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeManager's command extraction functionality, specifically testing behavior related to wake word detection and command parsing within a voice recognition context.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManagerExtractCommandTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple test cases to verify the behavior of command extraction logic in VoiceWakeManager.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNoTriggerFound
methods.description: Tests that extracting a command returns nil if the trigger word is not present in the transcript.

methods.name: extractCommandTrimsTokensAndResult
methods.description: Tests that the command extraction correctly trims tokens and returns the expected command string.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenGapTooShort
methods.description: Verifies that the command extraction returns nil if the post-trigger gap is shorter than the minimum required.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNothingAfterTrigger
methods.description: Ensures that the function returns nil if there is no command following the trigger word.

methods.name: extractCommandIgnoresEmptyTriggers
methods.description: Tests that empty or whitespace-only trigger phrases are ignored, and valid triggers are processed.
